sources.enumerated_scope: Six linked cultivars under Cultivars; all six individual pages checked for identity context. Separate wild-species and collection menus are outside this index count.
sources.limitations: Current visible index, not a complete historical breeding portfolio. Individual pages report identifiers and marketing traits; these are not official registry verification, current protection or confirmed traits. Comparator names, pedigree parents, nurseries and collection holdings are not automatically company's own cultivars. Fontaine's wild-strawberry hybrid context stays distinct from standard commercial strawberries. Photographer and image-specific reuse terms are unknown.
